  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "The moveable [1] appetizers are thus made: [2] {{ing_01|Small white beets}}, {{ing_02|mature leeks}}, {{ing_03|celery roots}} [3] {{ing_04|stewed cockles}} [4] {{ing_05|ginger}} [5] {{ing_06|chicken giblets}}, {{ing_07|small fowl}} [6] {{ing_08|small morsels cooked in their own liquor}} [7]."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "{{ing_09|Oil}} a pan, line it with {{ing_10|mallow leaves}} and a {{ing_11|composition of different vegetables}}, and, if you have room enough, {{ing_12|bulbs}}, {{ing_13|Damascus plums}}, {{ing_14|snails}}, {{ing_15|tid-bits}} [8] {{ing_16|short Lucanian sausage}} sliced."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Add {{ing_17|broth}}, {{ing_09|oil}}, {{ing_18|wine}}, {{ing_19|vinegar}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Put on the fire to heat and so cook them."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Meanwhile crush {{ing_20|pepper}}, {{ing_21|lovage}}, {{ing_05|ginger}}, {{ing_22|a little tarragon}}, moisten it and let it cook."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Break {{ing_23|several eggs}} in a dish, use the remaining liquor in the mortar to mix it with the sauce in the dish and to bind it."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "When this is done, make a wine sauce for it as follows: Crush {{ing_20|pepper}}, {{ing_21|lovage}}, moistened with {{ing_17|broth}}, {{ing_24|raisin wine}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "In a small sauce pan put a little {{ing_09|oil}} [with the other ingredients] heat, and bind with {{ing_25|roux}} when hot."
    },
    {
      "step": 9,
      "text": "Now [unmould] upset the dish on a platter, remove the {{ing_10|mallow leaves}}, pour over the wine sauce, sprinkle with {{ing_20|pepper}} and serve [9]."
    }
  ],
